name: system-dev-pipeline
description: Take a vague idea to a built system through a chain of gated, durable markdown artifacts — concept -> MVP description -> product spec -> test spec -> ERD/system architecture -> component detailed designs -> implementation — run as a workflow (per-milestone fan-out over components + E2E back-test) with a 3-tier feedback/escalation loop and a per-artifact critic at every gate. Single entry point: the `build-it` skill (the only registered surface); the stage instructions (clarify-product, product-manager, milestone-slicing, test-spec-generator, product-architect, prototype-runner, component-detailed-design, product-architect-reviewer, test-spec-critic) load on demand from references/stages/.
